title: English Practice Session (legacy hub format)
description: The validated individual-session format used by Mr. Rea's English Practice Hub. The legacy format has a category field but no separate course field.

id.description: Stable session identifier used by direct links such as ?session=types-of-sentences.

category.description: The legacy hub's only course/content grouping field.

listed.description: Controls homepage visibility; unlisted sessions still work through direct links.

submissionInstruction.description: Legacy per-session results instruction. See MIGRATION-NOTES.md for the runtime override limitation.

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index into choices. The legacy validator also checks that the index is smaller than the actual number of choices.

explanation.description: Instructional feedback shown immediately after an answer.

reviewTopic.description: Optional skill label used in the final performance-by-skill summary.
